// Classifier fixture, vitest: CONDITIONAL-ONLY, the CONDITIONAL and GUARDED-RETURN flags, and
// their negatives. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("conditional", () => {
  it("parses the year", () => {
    const result = parse("2024");
    if (result.ok) {
      expect(result.value.year).toBe(2024);
    }
  });

  it("creates the asset", () => {
    const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    expect(result.value.kind).toBe("image");
  });

  it("reports the load error", async () => {
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(LoadError);
    }
  });

  it("creates the asset after asserting success", () => {
    const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    expect(result.value.kind).toBe("image");
  });

  it("parses the year after asserting success", () => {
    const result = parse("2024");
    expect(result.ok).toBeTruthy();
    if (result.ok) {
      expect(result.value.year).toBe(2024);
    }
  });

  it("reads the profile after asserting it is present", () => {
    const profile = load();
    expect(profile).toBeDefined();
    if (profile === undefined) return;
    expect(profile.name).toBe("Ada");
  });

  it("reads the name after asserting its type", () => {
    const name = read();
    expect(name).toBeTypeOf("string");
    if (typeof name !== "string") return;
    expect(name.trim()).toBe("Ada");
  });

  it("adds both results after asserting each", () => {
    const first = parse("1");
    const second = parse("2");
    expect(first.ok).toBe(true);
    expect(second.ok).toBe(true);
    if (first.ok && second.ok) {
      expect(first.value + second.value).toBe(3);
    }
  });

  it("serves the stubbed post", async () => {
    if (useStub) {
      server.use({
        resolve() {
          return { id: "p1" };
        },
      });
    }
    expect(await fetchPost("p1")).toEqual({ id: "p1" });
  });

  it("reports the load error through catch", async () => {
    await load().catch((error) => {
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(LoadError);
    });
  });

  it("reports the load error, counted", async () => {
    expect.assertions(1);
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error.code).toBe("LOAD_FAILED");
    }
  });

  it("reports the load error through catch, counted", async () => {
    expect.hasAssertions();
    await load().catch((error) => {
      expect(error.code).toBe("LOAD_FAILED");
    });
  });

  it("reports the load error, counted with spaces", async () => {
    expect . assertions(1);
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error.code).toBe("LOAD_FAILED");
    }
  });

  it("reports the load error, counted by another object", async () => {
    tracker.assertions(1);
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error.code).toBe("LOAD_FAILED");
    }
  });

  it("reports the load error, counted through an alias", async () => {
    const check = expect;
    check.assertions(1);
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error.code).toBe("LOAD_FAILED");
    }
  });
});
